items.quote: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
items.claim: The LORD will show salvation to the people on this day, and the Egyptians will not be seen again
items.object: the salvation of the LORD, the Egyptians
